# 调查报告：CrowdStrike global IT outage on July 19, 2024

> **覆盖率** 17/17 槽位（100%）　**事实** 29 条　**来源 episode** 17 个

> 本报告仅消费图谱证据包。每条结论都标注了来源 episode；无证据的槽位如实标记为未查到，不做推断补全。

## WHO

**Primary Actor**
  - Faulty CrowdStrike update causes major global IT outage, taking out banks, airlines and businesses globally `aca723ab`
  来源：[2024 CrowdStrike-related IT outages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_CrowdStrike-related_IT_outages)
  ⚠️ no verified date: the sources did not state one explicitly；single source; no cross-corroboration

**Affected Parties**
  - a major global IT failure caused disruptions in a variety of industries, including airlines, media, banking, and merchants `22490e0c`
  来源：[Crowdstrike The Global IT Outage of 2024](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/385002313_Crowdstrike_The_Global_IT_Outage_of_2024)
  ⚠️ no verified date: the sources did not state one explicitly；single source; no cross-corroboration

**Related Organizations**
  - (Blackpoint Cyber) `baf84ace`
  - (KVIA) `baf84ace`
  - (SC Media) `baf84ace`
  - CrowdStrike, a leading cybersecurity firm `baf84ace`
  - Falcon sensor version 7.11 and above `baf84ace`
  来源：[Understanding the Crowdstrike Outage of July 19th, 2024 ...](https://www.accrete.ai/blog/understanding-the-crowdstrike-outage-of-july-19th-2024-and-how-ai-improves-it-resiliency)
  ⚠️ no verified date: the sources did not state one explicitly；single source; no cross-corroboration

**Regulators**
  - CISA will update this Alert with more information as it becomes available. `879c1f86`
  - CrowdStrike has published its Root Cause Analysis (RCA) report. `879c1f86`
  - Microsoft released a recovery tool that uses a USB drive to boot and repair affected systems.
Microsoft also published a blog post that provides links to various remediation solutions and outlines their actions in response to the outage, which include working with CrowdStrike to expedite restoring services to disrupted systems. `879c1f86`
  来源：[Widespread IT Outage Due to CrowdStrike Update](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2024/07/19/widespread-it-outage-due-crowdstrike-update)
  ⚠️ no verified date: the sources did not state one explicitly；single source; no cross-corroboration

## WHAT

**Core Event**
  - In the blog post, Microsoft estimates the outage affected 8.5 million Windows devices. `875b56a9`
  - Microsoft released a recovery tool that uses a USB drive to boot and repair affected systems. `875b56a9`
  - Widespread IT Outage Due to CrowdStrike Update `875b56a9`
  来源：[Widespread IT Outage Due to CrowdStrike Update | CISA](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2024/07/19/widespread-it-outage-due-crowdstrike-update)
  ⚠️ no verified date: the sources did not state one explicitly；single source; no cross-corroboration

**Scale**
  - The update triggered a memory error that led to system crashes and widespread Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) issues at private and public sector organizations globally. `1e0ccb4f`
  - a flawed update to CrowdStrike’s Falcon sensor, a cybersecurity tool widely used to protect devices like computer workstations and servers, resulted in a global IT outage. `1e0ccb4f`
  来源：[Monitoring and Support During the CrowdStrike Falcon Outage](https://www.cisecurity.org/insights/case-study/monitoring-and-support-during-the-crowdstrike-falcon-outage)
  ⚠️ no verified date: the sources did not state one explicitly；single source; no cross-corroboration

**Products**
  - "CrowdStrike's security software targets bad guys, not their malware" `b7227faf`

**Jurisdiction**

  来源：[Global IT outage live updates: Microsoft-CrowdStrike blackout](https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2024/07/19/latest-live-updates-on-a-major-it-outage-spreading-worldwide.html)
  ⚠️ single source; no cross-corroboration

## WHY

**Motivation**
  - when CrowdStrike (a major cybersecurity provider) released an update that inadvertently triggered one of the largest IT outages in history `08a3b6d6`
  来源：[Medium](https://medium.com/@euanw4872/global-it-outage-how-crowdstrike-navigated-reputational-challenges-and-stakeholder-confidence-in-b3a5183fd115)
  ⚠️ no verified date: the sources did not state one explicitly；single source; no cross-corroboration

**Trigger**
  - CrowdStrike, a leading cybersecurity firm, deployed a faulty update for its Falcon Sensor software `6eeb9483`
  来源：[CrowdStrike Causes Global Microsoft Outage: A Case Study](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/393170974_CrowdStrike_Causes_Global_Microsoft_Outage_A_Case_Study)
  ⚠️ no verified date: the sources did not state one explicitly；single source; no cross-corroboration

## HOW

**Mechanism**
  - The flawed update was distributed globally without a staggered rollout or full regression testing, which significantly amplified its impact `c14eb3f9`
  - The issue stemmed from a driver parsing failure, which caused widespread “blue screen of death” errors, rendering the affected machines inoperable until they were manually repaired `c14eb3f9`
  - This update contained a malformed content file that triggered a critical driver-level error on Microsoft Windows systems `c14eb3f9`
  - a faulty software update from cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike caused what is broadly considered one of the most widespread IT outages in history `c14eb3f9`
